segments.title: This tortoise is 194 YEARS old
segments.say: This tortoise is one hundred ninety four years old. And his DNA may explain why.

segments.title: Oldest land animal alive
segments.say: He's the oldest known land animal alive.

segments.title: Scientists read his DNA
segments.say: A team led by the University of Cambridge read his DNA.

segments.title: Rare gene variants
segments.say: They found unusual gene variants that may help explain his long life.

segments.title: Source: Science Advances
segments.say: The study is in the journal Science Advances.
